title: Worker detail drawer
description: Drawer component showing: full config, recent job history (last 20 jobs), heartbeat chart (Recharts), connection details.
definitionOfDone: Drawer shows: full worker config, capabilities list, pool info
Recent job history: last 20 jobs with status and duration
Connection details: address, connected since, version

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/agents/WorkerDetailDrawer.tsx: Uses existing Drawer component (size='lg'). Props: workerId (string | null), onClose. Fetches useWorker(id) and useWorkerJobs(id) when workerId is set. Sections: (1) Header: worker name, status badge, pool name. (2) Config: capabilities list as Badge components, address, connected since, version. (3) Recent jobs: table of last 20 jobs (ID, status badge, duration, topic). (4) Heartbeat chart: Recharts LineChart showing heartbeat timestamps over last hour (simple ping timeline). (5) Connection details: address, protocol version, uptime formatted.
implementationPlan.note: Created WorkerDetailDrawer with: header (name + status badge + pool), capabilities badge list, connection details grid (address, version, uptime, last heartbeat, load), heartbeat Recharts LineChart (step-after, last hour, 5min intervals), recent jobs table (ID, status badge, topic, duration). Uses Drawer size=lg.

implementationPlan.description: Wire WorkerDetailDrawer into AgentsPage.tsx: click worker row (table) or card (grid view) sets selectedWorkerId state, opens drawer. Drawer onClose clears selection.
implementationPlan.note: Wired WorkerDetailDrawer into AgentsPage. Table rows get cursor-pointer + onClick. PoolGroupedView gets onWorkerClick prop (threaded through PoolSection → WorkerCard). WorkerCard cards become clickable. Drawer opens on click, closes on onClose.
